definitions.explanation: Covering a wide area or scope. Used to describe things that span a large range, whether physical areas, topics, fields of activity, or effects.

examples.japanese: {広範|こうはん}な⟦{調査|ちょうさ}→調査：03489_chousa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}った→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{広範|こうはん}な⟦{分野|ぶんや}→分野：03612_bunya⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{影響|えいきょう}→影響：01877_eikyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{与|あた}えている→与える：01821_ataeru⟧。
examples.english: That problem is affecting a wide range of fields.

examples.japanese: ⟦{台風|たいふう}→台風：01455_taifuu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{広範|こうはん}な⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{被害|ひがい}→被害：02572_higai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦もたらし→もたらす：10546_motarasu⟧、⟦{復旧|ふっきゅう}→復旧：07521_fukkyuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{時間|じかん}がかかる→時間がかかる：26082_jikangakakaru⟧⟦{見通|みとお}し→見通し：10566_mitooshi⟧だ。
examples.english: The typhoon caused damage over a wide area, and recovery is expected to take time.

notes:
USAGE:
Used as a na-adjective: {広範|こうはん}な～. Often appears in the longer form ⟦{広範囲|こうはんい}→広範囲：17171_kouhani⟧ (wide range/area) which functions as both a noun and a na-adjective. Common in formal writing, news, and academic contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {広範|こうはん}な⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧: extensive area
- {広範|こうはん}な⟦{分野|ぶんや}→分野：03612_bunya⟧: wide range of fields
- {広範|こうはん}な⟦{知識|ちしき}→知識：01463_chishiki⟧: broad knowledge
- {広範|こうはん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧わたる: extending over a wide range
